title: California Attorney General asks FBI to investigate Newton

tellings.quote: On April 25th, 1951, he had the California Attorney General's office contact the FBI to look into Newton, questioning his claims of conducting secret government research and accusing him of being in on a hoax.

plain: On April 25, 1951, the California Attorney General's office contacted the FBI to look into a man named Silas Newton, questioning his claims to be doing secret government research and accusing him of taking part in a hoax, according to Michels. He tells it from the FBI's files on Newton and his partner Leo GeBauer, in an episode about stories of crashed craft and alien bodies, and he names a man called JP Khan as the one who set the inquiry in motion. It matters because Newton's claims were among the early crash stories, and the files show officials doubted him at the time.
